name: Test of Lore
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
So the time is once again upon us. As a student of lore, you have shown great tenacity by undertaking my task.

And so now I offer you your question. If you are ready, speak to me again, and take all the time you need, adventurer--there is no pressure to answer quickly.
narrative.objectives: Answer Parqual Fintallas' question successfully and then speak to him again. He will remain in the Undercity until you are ready.
narrative.offerRewardText: Well done, adventurer. I had my doubts if you studied the text I asked you to get, but you've answered correctly.
narrative.requestItemsText:
There is only one rule I feel you must know if you wish to survive in this world: the more you know, the more you'll see.

If you study, if you observe, then you will begin to see things in the world that no other friend will see.

chain.subtitle: 10 quests from level 26 to 36, 17,600 XP in all.

quests.name: Test of Faith
quests.objectiveText: If you have faith, leap from the planks overlooking Thousand Needles.

quests.name: Test of Endurance
quests.objectiveText: Bring Grenka's Claw to Dorn Plainstalker in Thousand Needles.

quests.name: Test of Strength
quests.objectiveText: Bring Fragments of Rok'Alim to Dorn Plainstalker in Thousand Needles.

quests.name: Test of Lore
quests.objectiveText: Find Braug Dimspirit near the entrance to Talondeep Path in Stonetalon Mountains.

quests.name: Test of Lore
quests.objectiveText: Find the Legacy of the Aspects and return it to Braug Dimspirit near the entrance to Talondeep Path in Stonetalon Mountains.

quests.name: Test of Lore
quests.objectiveText: Answer Braug Dimspirit's question successfully and then speak to him again.

quests.name: Test of Lore
quests.objectiveText: Find The Beginnings of the Undead Threat, and return it to Parqual Fintallas in Undercity.

quests.name: Test of Lore
quests.objectiveText: Answer Parqual Fintallas' question successfully and then speak to him again.

quests.name: Final Passage
quests.objectiveText: Speak to Dorn Plainstalker in Thousand Needles.
